sourceNote: Guardians Rising: Sun & Moon (GX-era) aggregate model, confidence LOW. Community box breakdowns (dripshop Team Up study, Pokecompare, Flipside Gaming) put holo GX at ~1:6-9 packs, full-art GX/trainer ~1:20, and rainbow/gold secret ~1:60 each. Folded onto the two normalized tiers this set has: ultra_rare (Rare Holo GX + Rare Ultra full arts) ~0.18/pack, hyper_rare (Rainbow + Secret) ~0.03/pack. Tier values come from live PriceCharting card prices, so per-set EV differences reflect real card values, not the odds. Box price validated against a real 2025 eBay sold comp for the era (Cosmic Eclipse box ~$3,275 sold Dec 2025).
